indices.name: S&P 500
indices.explain: The 500 biggest US companies. When people say 'the market', they usually mean this.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.explain: Tech-heavy index of 3,000+ stocks on the Nasdaq exchange (Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft…).

indices.name: Dow Jones
indices.explain: 30 large, famous US companies. Old and narrow, but still quoted on the news daily.

indices.name: 10-yr Treasury
indices.explain: Interest rate the US government pays to borrow for 10 years. Drives mortgage rates and stock valuations.

indices.name: Bitcoin
indices.explain: The largest cryptocurrency, often treated as a gauge of investors' appetite for risk.
